import random, sys, json, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp/dev')
from harness import *
rng = random.Random(7)
N = 8192
fib = []; seen=set()
while len(fib) < N:
    L = rng.choice([rng.randint(0,16), rng.randint(17,64), rng.randint(65,128)])
    a = ref.mask(rng.getrandbits(128), L)
    if (a,L) in seen: continue
    seen.add((a,L)); fib.append((a, L, rng.randint(0,4194302)))
queries = random_queries(rng, fib, 200)
ops = [['put', hx(a), l, h] for (a,l,h) in fib]
ops += [['query',[hx(a) for a in queries]], ['save'], ['load_saved',0], ['image_query',[hx(a) for a in queries]]]
req = {'cases':[{'ops':ops}]}
raw = json.dumps(req).encode()
print('request bytes', len(raw))
t0=time.time(); resp = run(req); t1=time.time()
print('native+frontend time %.2fs' % (t1-t0))
img = resp['results'][0]['snapshots'][0]
t0=time.time(); ok,reason = ref.validate_image(img); t1=time.time()
print('python validate %.2fs -> %s %s' % (t1-t0, ok, reason))
json.dump(img, open('/workspace/tmp/dev/scale_img.json','w'))
# pure frontend parse time
import subprocess
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c','''
import sys; sys.path.insert(0,"/workspace")
import run as r
data = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
w = r.parse(data)
print(len(w))
'''], input=raw, capture_output=True)
t1=time.time()
